basis: Built current working tree; declarations are metadata, not behavioral acceptance. Unowned packing changes are not qualified by this task.

subsets.name: bounded-opc
subsets.reason: Bounded ZIP/OPC read and validated publication; encrypted and multi-disk packages reject. Full schema validation is not provided.

subsets.name: original-dialect
subsets.reason: Admit Strict and Transitional dialects and edit only supported structures in the original dialect. No implicit conversion or full schema certification.

subsets.name: macro-free-kinds
subsets.reason: Read and create original DOCX and DOTX packages with explicit kind. Macro-enabled mutations reject; suffixes do not establish package kind.

subsets.name: opaque-xml-retention
subsets.reason: Namespace-aware bounded edits retain unmodified opaque XML. Recognition does not authorize semantic edits; affected unsupported structures reject.

subsets.name: declared-compatibility-profile
subsets.reason: Bounded logical reads use the declared understood-namespace profile. Unselected alternate branches remain preserved; unknown MustUnderstand requirements and affected unsupported branches reject. No blanket extension support.

subsets.name: explicit-inventory-packing
subsets.reason: Sorted authenticated VFS records, retained kind/dialect and exact opaque bytes; complete graph validation and one deterministic staged publication. No scanning or ambient files.

subsets.name: exclusive-archive-extraction
subsets.reason: Whole namespace admission, exact all/media-only bytes and optional pretty XML into a new explicit tree; conditional VFS directory/file creation and explicit partial-output consent. No rollback or live-model claim.

subsets.name: bounded-comparison
subsets.reason: Explicit package payload/XML or story text/structure scope. Both inputs share cumulative retention, XML, work and change budgets; no rendering, ID renumbering or host I/O.

subsets.name: record-template-filling
subsets.reason: Exact tagged body control bindings, typed records and native nested rows/sections; four repeat levels, 1,000 items per region and cumulative budgets. Empty arrays retain reusable cleared prototypes. IDs and occurrence-local relationships remap before one publication; no expressions or host access. Template utility batches and whole model APIs remain pending.

subsets.name: selective-sanitization
subsets.reason: Fixed-order explicit properties/comments/revisions/links/objects actions with exact effects and retained gaps; unsupported affected review/objects reject before publication. No comprehensive privacy or recoverability promise; utility batches remain unsupported.

subsets.name: seeded-selected-dummy-text
subsets.reason: Required seed, paragraph-local original vocabulary, explicit count or whitespace-delimited logical span count; retain formatting and nontext data. Not anonymization; no time, randomness, networking or external generator. Generic utility batches and live owners remain pending.

subsets.name: bounded-content-removal
subsets.reason: Explicit paragraph/run scalar endpoints and marker inclusion; whole paragraphs, runs and tables. Section breaks, required empty paragraphs and all resource graphs survive. Affected annotations, notes, fields, review and graphics reject; no cross-container ranges, resource garbage collection or utility batches.

subsets.name: signature-structure-inventory
subsets.reason: Exact declared OPC origin, relationship and part roles, including external metadata; cryptographic validity is unknown.

subsets.name: explicit-signature-removal
subsets.reason: Complete safe signature graph and content-type removal with exact reports. Default mutations reject signed input; no regeneration or generic utility batch execution.

subsets.name: inert-object-inventory-extraction
subsets.reason: OLE/package relationships, shape-bound previews and shared resources; exact bounded VFS payload extraction. No activation, binary decoding or linked fetch. Macro/protection state remains unknown unless declared; external targets are redacted.

subsets.name: physical-equation-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-global physical outer math units with inert stored/global properties and inactive/opaque preservation.

subsets.name: bounded-equation-fragments
subsets.reason: Explicit whole-paragraph append or same-root unit replacement using matching-dialect bounded fragments. Full schema, evaluation, conversion, layout, rendering, utility batch execution and live math models remain unsupported.

subsets.name: physical-diagram-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-global physical role candidates and native bindings with inert graph closure, including orphan parts. Preserve-only snapshots imply no semantic editing, activation, rendering, external acquisition or live model support.

subsets.name: opaque-graphics-preservation
subsets.reason: Eligible unknown graphics and extensions remain separately qualified opaque observations, including inactive alternatives. Unknown-only evidence does not establish a known diagram; utility batch execution remains unsupported.

subsets.name: physical-chart-part-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-wide definitions, including unreferenced parts, with ordered plot groups, indexed string/numeric/multilevel caches and inert formula metadata. Cached freshness unknown; no active occurrence, formula engine, workbook validation or rendering claim.

subsets.name: opaque-chart-preservation
subsets.reason: Extension/wrong-profile definitions remain explicitly opaque. Workbook/style/color descriptors and physical graph references stay inert; utility batch and live models are unsupported.

subsets.name: native-shape-inventory
subsets.reason: Active native, Office and VML shape/group occurrences with hierarchy, stored metadata, text-box story owners and physical section references. No rendering, geometry editing or live drawing models.

subsets.name: simple-text-box-assignment
subsets.reason: Whole simple admitted ungrouped box text assignment replaces run formatting and retains paragraph properties/geometry. Preserving scoped text editors reuse carrier authority. Nested/grouped, linked, opaque, multiple-body and shared-header edits reject; no implicit shared edits or utility batch execution.

subsets.name: inline-png-jpeg-insertion
subsets.reason: Original bounded utility insertion of admitted PNG/JPEG bytes into one whole paragraph or admitted body/cell/explicit header/note block container. Native per-axis DPI with independent 72 fallback, explicit physical units, checked contain/cover/stretch and decorative/alt intent. Known suffixes must match bytes; retained exact media and capability publication. Five-format header metadata characterization does not imply insertion of GIF/BMP/TIFF. Floating authoring, SVG without a supplied fallback, pixel decoding, rendering and image-part, drawing and collection models remain unsupported. The separate static SVG/fallback insertion subset is qualified under F35.

subsets.name: standalone-image-values
subsets.reason: Immutable PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP and TIFF values with bounded headers, effective DPI, native and scaled lengths, owned bytes and compatibility SHA-1. No image-part, shape or collection authority; insertion support remains separate.

subsets.name: raster-occurrence-replacement
subsets.reason: Direct bounded PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP and TIFF occurrence replacement clones and rebinds one drawing; explicit shared intent rebinds the resolved resource across physical owners. Default geometry and inactive references remain preserved. Linked/alternate/fallback replacement, utility batch execution and live image-part/drawing/collection models remain pending.

subsets.name: image-inventory-extraction
subsets.reason: Bounded selected occurrence/resource inventory and exact original-byte VFS extraction with explicit manifest-inclusive publication intent. Unknown geometry/media stays null or opaque preserve-only; linked resources remain inert. No pixel decoding, DPI/native-size, rendering, live model or full image parity.

subsets.name: stored-image-layout
subsets.reason: Read admitted native extents, crop, rotation, flips, wrap, z-order, separate axis positions and alt/decorative metadata. Unsupported or invalid metadata stays null with warnings; no rendering is inferred.

subsets.name: native-picture-layout
subsets.reason: Direct bounded edits of coherent existing native picture extents, crop, transform, aspect locks and metadata; admitted anchors support separate axis frames, offsets or alignments, distances, stacking and explicit wrapping polygons. Exact media, relationships and admitted coherent alternate associations are preserved. Inline conversion, rendering, utility batch execution and live drawing/collection models remain unsupported.

subsets.name: inert-image-alternatives
subsets.reason: Selected core-v1 carrier references and exact admitted internal alternate/fallback bytes; raw selected VML remains preserve-only. Inactive MCE evidence stays preserved; no Choice activation, unsupported decoding or external acquisition.

subsets.name: shared-image-owners
subsets.reason: Occurrence-local geometry and exact selected-owner references remain distinct from shared byte hashes. Unique groups after selection with first selected representative and no null-hash grouping; Live shared-image models remain pending.

subsets.name: explicit-shared-raster-replacement
subsets.reason: Explicit direct replacement targets the resolved internal resource across owner-local relationships, preserving geometry and reporting each physical owner. Filename and byte-hash equality never establish shared identity. Utility batch and live model execution remain pending.

subsets.name: static-svg-fallback-insertion
subsets.reason: Direct inline insertion of bounded static safe SVG XML with explicitly supplied validated PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP or TIFF fallback. Fallback pixel dimensions and per-axis DPI supply native geometry; original SVG/fallback bytes, distinct media parts and owner-local relationships form one coherent occurrence. No fetching, rasterization, pixel decoding, MCE activation or rendering parity. Floating insertion, SVG/fallback replacement, utility batch execution and live image-part/drawing/collection models remain unsupported.

subsets.name: typed-document-properties
subsets.reason: Read and explicitly set/remove admitted core, extended and custom scalar metadata. Exact qualified or unambiguous stored names; UTC whole-second utility strings and retained custom variants/IDs. Missing-part creation is explicit and collision-safe. Cached, opaque, invalid and ambiguous metadata stays read/preserve-only; unrelated timestamps, counts and XML remain unchanged. No live CoreProperties/model, automatic clocks, recalculation or corpus conformance claim.

subsets.name: control-values
subsets.reason: Bounded plain/rich scalar text, declared checkbox glyphs, stored choice values, numeric Gregorian dates and existing internal PNG picture replacement. Indexed nested/unsupported controls remain inspected. Locked or bound filling, parent replacement erasing nested controls and unsupported affected structures reject atomically. Declared binding synchronization uses the separate controls bind route. Live model owners and ordered batches remain unsupported.

subsets.name: native-repetition
subsets.reason: Bounded native block and unmerged grid-row repetition from exact scalar records, including empty reusable placeholders. Remap contained IDs, bookmarks, classic comments and admitted inline PNG drawings while retaining shared media. Affected bindings, locks, review, opaque structures and crossing ownership reject. Template apply, live owners and ordered batches remain pending.

subsets.name: binding-synchronization
subsets.reason: Declared tag keys identify one internal custom XML singleton and all complete scoped recipients, including aliases. Root-inclusive namespace-resolved child paths and explicit string/boolean/integer/double types preserve false, zero and empty values. Unresolved same-store recipients, incomplete scope, ambiguity and locks reject before publication. No binding detachment or resource fetch.

subsets.name: revision-decisions
subsets.reason: Direct acceptance/rejection of ordinary inline text wrappers and supported exposed-field run/paragraph property history. Scoped ordinal, whole revision token or explicit all; validate every selected candidate before edits, preserving unselected review and required owners. Nested/compound/move/table/section/opaque review and affected field/control/range boundaries reject. Live owners and ordered batches remain unsupported.

subsets.name: tracked-text-creation
subsets.reason: Explicit-author/time insertion, deletion and literal replacement on admitted scalar text ranges. Preserve original/final/all views and run properties; affected existing review and compound boundaries reject. Acceptance/rejection is a separate bounded subset; live owners and ordered batches remain unsupported.

subsets.name: revision-read-views
subsets.reason: Final/original/all text and run/paragraph property snapshots; IDs, authors and stored timestamps. Ordinary unrelated edits preserve review markup. Tracked creation and acceptance/rejection are separately bounded editing subsets.

subsets.name: complex-revision-inventory
subsets.reason: Move wrappers/range markers and opaque table, section and extension revisions; affected complex edits reject.

subsets.name: classic-comments
subsets.reason: Explicit author/time and run-boundary body anchors; list/get/set/remove comments, preserving unrelated annotations. Rich block replacement, comment batches and live model owners remain pending.

subsets.name: comment-extension-synchronization
subsets.reason: Inventories extension parts and IDs; single-paragraph text edits retain thread links and resolution. Removal synchronizes verified IDs and people; surviving replies, opaque affected metadata and unverified structures reject. Thread authoring remains unsupported.

subsets.name: footnotes-endnotes
subsets.reason: Read, insert, edit and remove notes and references with reserved separator preservation, scoped IDs and explicit shared-reference policies. Document and section numbering/restart rules remain intact; storage renumbering does not calculate pagination or displayed numbers. Live document model remains pending.

subsets.name: toc-caption-structures
subsets.reason: Bounded TOC levels, inert caption sequences and static labels. Explicit cached text and dirty flags; no layout or sequence evaluation. Existing sequence collisions require explicit reuse.

subsets.name: cached-fields
subsets.reason: List simple, complex and nested fields; edit supported plain cached results without execution. Preserve instructions, formatting and omitted flags. Create bounded fields and edit typed instructions. Nested-result replacement, shared-story editing and live model remain pending.

subsets.name: bookmark-ranges
subsets.reason: List, create, rename and remove checked ranges; explicit reference policy for internal links and REF/PAGEREF fields. Multi-run paragraph and table-cell boundaries; stale, missing, duplicate and crossing structures checked. Complex reference removal, shared-story edits and general field/model APIs remain unsupported.

subsets.name: hyperlinks
subsets.reason: Create, list, retarget and unwrap direct paragraph hyperlinks; explicit label deletion. Inert HTTP/HTTPS/mailto and internal anchors, owner-scoped relationship cleanup. Shared story edits and live hyperlink model remain pending.

subsets.name: logical-grid
subsets.reason: Inspect logical owners and spans. Explicit rectangular merges join blocks in row order; split restores existing grid slots with anchor or paragraph distribution. Covered writes require owner intent. Row deletion preserves surviving spans. Omitted/wrapped grids, legacy merges and span insertion/column removal remain unsupported.

subsets.name: table-construction
subsets.reason: Bounded rectangular grids, nested typed blocks, repeated leading headers, borders/shading, margins and row height/splitting. Selected cell values and table/row/cell formatting, explicit rectangular row/column insertion and deletion. Merged grids support explicit merge/split and row removal; omitted grids remain readable. Span insertion, column removal and live table owners remain pending.

subsets.name: multilevel-numbering
subsets.reason: Bounded list add/set, levels 0-8, scoped IDs and start/restart overrides; resolve paragraph and numbering style links. Preserve mixed levels and unrelated opaque schemes/picture resources. Advanced level-definition setters and live numbering model remain pending.

subsets.name: header-footer-stories
subsets.reason: Noncreating reads of every variant; explicit shared edits, local clone/rebind and removal. Preserve cached fields and outgoing resources; scoped paragraph/text operations reuse story ownership. Whole-story text rejects fields, tables and opaque blocks. Live document model and general image/table editing remain pending.

subsets.name: section-page-settings
subsets.reason: Edit owner-local geometry, columns, section starts, page-number and first-page metadata; append sections and inventory inherited header/footer bindings. Even/odd policy is document-wide and requires explicit all-section scope. No pagination claim.

subsets.name: package-resource-inventories
subsets.reason: Package-global customXML and glossary metadata, whole-part locations, ancillary closure and inert external references. Missing or ambiguous metadata remains preserved with bounded warnings; no content dump, import, schema fetch or semantic editing.

subsets.name: opaque-package-retention
subsets.reason: Retain unedited ancillary payloads and relationship XML across admitted mutations. Bound raw replacements and unsupported same-store recipients reject rather than detach or partially synchronize.

subsets.name: settings-and-protection
subsets.reason: Package-global stored settings, compatibility, field-update and font embedding flags; credential-free protection state. Only raw boolean field-update intent is editable. Protected packages and changed locked controls reject; unchanged locked owners survive scoped text replacement. Unknown settings remain preserved; no rights bypass, password verification or font installation.

subsets.name: theme-and-font-resources
subsets.reason: Inspect theme colors, major/minor/script fonts, font tables, embedding metadata and reference diagnostics. Preserve embedded bytes and language metadata; embedded font mutation is unsupported. No installation, availability, licensing or rasterization inference.

subsets.name: title-and-heading-creation
subsets.reason: Level 0 creates Title; levels 1-9 create paragraph headings through creation and paragraph insertion. Deterministic style IDs preserve conflicting user definitions and reuse compatible built-ins. Model methods remain pending.

subsets.name: style-definitions
subsets.reason: Paragraph, character and table styles; defaults, inheritance, linked styles and heading definitions. Latent defaults and individual visibility, priority, locking and gallery metadata are editable. Live style collections, inherited font/paragraph objects, latent entries and owned typed batches are implemented; document content model operations remain pending.

subsets.name: paragraph-editing
subsets.reason: Direct paragraph properties and whole text; block and inline caret insertion with suffix retention. Explicit breaks, sorted tab stops, border sides and shading; style-owned paragraph model handles are implemented.

subsets.name: bounded-ordered-utility-batch
subsets.reason: F47: Version 1 ordered typed operations with stable IDs, whole-array syntax admission, staged selections, shared budgets, final validation and one publication. Admitted IDs: fields.add, fields.set, toc.add, toc.set, captions.add, captions.set, paragraphs.add, paragraphs.set, runs.add, tables.add, tables.set, tables.rows.add, tables.rows.remove, tables.columns.add, tables.columns.remove, tables.merge, tables.split, text.replace, lorem.set, runs.set, images.add, images.replace, images.set, properties.set, properties.remove, text.get, fields.list, tables.get, images.list, images.get, properties.list, properties.get. Other utility and live model batches remain pending.

subsets.name: scoped-direct-run-formatting
subsets.reason: Run or paragraph scalar ranges; nullable direct properties, explicit font/theme references and half-point sizes. No style resolution, font loading, whole-text assignment or whole document model execution.

subsets.name: structured-creation
subsets.reason: DOCX/DOTX, Strict/Transitional; original paragraphs/tables and explicit new-package settings; append-only supplied templates.

subsets.name: inventory
subsets.reason: No rendering, linked-resource access or signature verification.

subsets.name: core-v1
subsets.reason: Partial core-v1 validation only.

subsets.name: logical-story-text
subsets.reason: Explicit story scopes and review views; hidden text included, cached field results only; no drawing/equation text or rendering.

subsets.name: logical-unicode
subsets.reason: Unicode order and direct language/RTL/font properties; no shaping or style cascade.

subsets.name: explicit-xml-part
subsets.reason: Validated whole-part replacement; immutable opaque content, no protection bypass; raw bytes or bounded display serialization.

subsets.name: literal-paragraph-text
subsets.reason: Nonoverlapping original-text matches, run formatting preservation, explicit cardinality and bold/italic overrides; structural barriers, protected and shared parts guarded.
